summary: Berks Catholic High School urges the FCC to maintain E‑Rate funding to avoid significant cost burdens and instructional disruptions.

claims.argument: Cutting E‑Rate would force the school to absorb large recurring technology costs, delaying upgrades and shifting expenses to families.
